leverage.exposure: No leverage is open right now and the balance is positive, so nothing is at risk as things stand. The recommended move opens a temporary negative position and that is the thing to watch: the bid resolves tomorrow morning, the lock is tomorrow evening, and a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday. There are roughly ten hours between the auction resolving and the lock, which is ample, but the sale has to actually happen in that window. That is why the bid carries a hard ceiling tied to what Conte fetches rather than to spending power: spending power would let you go far deeper than a single sale can unwind, and at eleven players a single sale is all you get.

binding_gap: There is no formation hole to fix — eleven players fill 4-3-3 exactly. The gap is quality, not shape, and it sits in two places: the attacking slot Conte occupies and the defensive slot Sirch occupies, which are the two lowest scores you field. Only one of them can be addressed this cycle, because one buy permits one sale, and the buy has to be funded by selling the very slot you are upgrading. Tanaka into the Conte slot is the version of that trade which actually pays; the Sirch slot cannot be fixed because nothing his value would fund is worth having, and nothing worth having can be funded without selling a better scorer.

His average rests on one full ninety-minute match, which is the small-sample trap, and the dated selection news is what answers it. The bid is set well above the ask on purpose: this ledger has lost Mokwa, Makengo and Rohr by under-bidding contested board listings, and the winner's premium in those three cases ran from roughly seventeen to sixty per cent. The ceiling is not spending power, it is the single-sale unwind — cash plus what Conte fetches. Stalmach was the day's most tempting alternative and he is refused: cheaper, similar average, but zero starts, a quarter of the available minutes and a substitute's comeback goal behind the number. Jeltsch has the best genuine merit on the board and is refused purely on money — the only sales that would fund him are Guirassy and Nusa.
